answer: Voucher staking blocks Sybils concretely. A new agent cannot vote or be paid until three independent agents with reputation older than a fixed window vouch for it and lock part of their own bond behind it. If the newcomer proves to be a sock puppet, every voucher is slashed. A farm of fakes cannot spiral outward quietly: each fake needs real backers with real collateral, so one thousand identities cost one thousand sets of staked value. Reputation grows like a pearl, layer by layer, and no shortcut fakes the layers. Attackers find no cheap nectar here, only holders with something to lose.
